edges.reason: balanceOf reads _rOwned[account] to derive the token balance.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned[sender] and _rOwned[recipient].
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the team reflections.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_getCurrentSupply reads the constant _tTotal as the token supply.
_transfer uses _tTotal to compute the 2% early wallet limit.
_getValues reads the _taxFee state variable.
_getTValues multiplies tAmount by the tax fee rate.
_getValues reads the _teamFee state variable.
_getTValues multiplies tAmount by the team fee rate.
sendETHToFee transfers the amount to the _FeeAddress.
swapTokensForEth calls uniswapV2Router.WETH() and the router swap.
openTrading writes and uses the uniswapV2Router state variable.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to gate the swap logic.
openTrading assigns the pair address returned by createPair.
setBots refuses to blacklist the uniswapV2Pair address.
_transfer requires tradingOpen and uses it to gate swapping.
_transfer checks inSwap before performing the contract swap.
swapTokensForEth is guarded by lockTheSwap which toggles inSwap.
_transfer compares walletLimitDuration against block.timestamp.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_transfer requires that neither from nor to is blacklisted in _bots.
renounceOwnership reads and zeroes the _owner state variable.
openTrading passes owner() as the liquidity recipient, reading _owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender of the allowance.
The constructor mints _rTotal to _msgSender().
excludeFromFee authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
includeToFee authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
setTeamFee authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
setTaxFee authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
manualswap authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
manualsend authorises the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
The address supplied by the user flows into _transfer as the from argument.
block.timestamp drives the walletLimitDuration early-buy restriction.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used both as the liquidity deadline and to set walletLimitDuration.
_transfer ends by delegating to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move the balances.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the transfer when takeFee is false.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to obtain all amounts.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token-side amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection-side amounts.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for the supply pair.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team fee to reflections.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call that can re-enter the token.
sendETHToFee performs an external value transfer to the fee address.
openTrading approves the router for _tTotal through _approve.
openTrading calls the factory createPair external function.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH forwarding the whole contract ETH balance.
openTrading approves the pair contract for max uint.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection on the reflection balance.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
The external ETH transfer to _FeeAddress executes before state settles and can re-enter _transfer.
The Uniswap router swap can call back into the token, reaching _transfer during the swap.
The rFee value computed by _getRValues (tFee * currentRate) feeds the _rTotal subtraction.
The tTransferAmount and fee amounts from _getTValues flow into the balance arithmetic of _transferStandard.
The current rate from _getRate divides the reflection amount in tokenFromReflection.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter FeeAddress is only used to initialise _FeeAddress inside the constructor.
Local msgSender is a transient copy of _msgSender() used only for the constructor mint and event.
The from parameter is consumed by _transfer for all address checks and balance updates.
The to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
The amount parameter drives the whole _transfer computation.
Local takeFee is computed and used only within _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed solely inside _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance is computed and consumed solely inside _transfer.
Local walletBalance is used only for the _transfer early-buy limit check.
The tokenAmount parameter is used only by swapTokensForEth for the swap and approval.
Local path is built and passed to the router only inside swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is used only as the transfer value in sendETHToFee.
The sender parameter of _tokenTransfer is forwarded directly into _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter of _tokenTransfer is forwarded directly into _transferStandard.
The amount parameter of _tokenTransfer is forwarded directly into _transferStandard.
The takeFee parameter of _tokenTransfer controls removeAllFee/restoreAllFee inside it.
The tAmount parameter is only used inside _transferStandard.
The bots_ array is iterated and consumed only inside setBots.
The notbot parameter is only used to update _bots[notbot] in delBot.
The ad parameter is only used to set the fee exemption in excludeFromFee.
The ad parameter is only used to clear the fee exemption in includeToFee.
The team parameter is validated and assigned to _teamFee in setTeamFee.
The tax parameter is validated and assigned to _taxFee in setTaxFee.
The owner parameter is only used inside _approve for the allowance mapping.
The spender parameter is only used inside _approve for the allowance mapping.
The amount parameter is only stored by _approve.
The owner parameter is only a lookup key in allowance.
The spender parameter is only a lookup key in allowance.
The account parameter is only a lookup key in balanceOf.
The recipient parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer.
The amount parameter is forwarded by transfer into _transfer.
The spender parameter is forwarded by approve into _approve.
The amount parameter is forwarded by approve into _approve.
The sender parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer.
The recipient parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer.
The amount parameter of transferFrom is used for both the transfer and allowance maths.
The rAmount parameter is only used by tokenFromReflection to compute the token amount.
